title: Reviewer Finding
description:
One thing a reviewer found, stated so that closing it is checkable. Every field answers a question the implementer would otherwise have to ask: which requirement, where, what was observed, what it costs, and what would have to be true to close it. A finding missing any of those is a complaint rather than a work item.

The severity and status vocabularies are generated from src/ledger.mjs, because `recordReview` checks a decision against its own findings and a value the schema allowed but the ledger did not recognise would slip past every one of those checks.
